QUOTE: On GCC/Clang-style compilers, `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` is defined when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is on (it is by default, `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:52`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is defined from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus a compiler gate (`defined(__GNUC__) && ...` with `__ARMCC_VERSION`). That makes it derived rather than set in the config file.
